final_draft.answer: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
final_draft.note: I used the approved answer for control A1.2 word for word. Its owner is security@harborlight.example and it is valid until 2027-11-16. It only covers production databases. If the customer is asking about backups of other systems, like file storage or config, we don't have an approved answer for those.

answer:7db75d70-c5e5-4fc5-b935-3b3d23712: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
answer:a36bede8-f98b-45d2-b01e-bf04274a0: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:cfdc68e2-5b56-4429-8fb3-6250fbb7e: We test our disaster recovery plan annually. The last test was in March 2026 and met the recovery time objective of four hours.
policy:e38e552d-20d4-4187-ad6d-5498ddc92: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:c2bcb499-13d5-4c5b-a267-4839e03f6: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
